q: कश्मीर/पोतवार क्षेत्र (वर्तमान पाकिस्तान) के किस पुरापाषाणकालीन स्थल के नाम पर उत्तर-पश्चिम भारत की "पेबल / चॉपर-चॉपिंग उपकरण संस्कृति" का नाम पड़ा?
e: The Sohan (Soan) River Valley culture (studied by de Terra & Paterson, 1935) is characterized by pebble chopper-chopping tools, whereas the Madrasian/Acheulian culture of South India is known for hand-axes and cleavers.
qe: Which Palaeolithic site in the Kashmir/Potwar region (now in Pakistan) gave its name to the "Pebble / Chopper-Chopping Tool Culture" of North-West India?

q: असम (पूर्वोत्तर भारत) के किस नवपाषाणकालीन स्थल से विशिष्ट "स्कंधयुक्त कुल्हाड़ियाँ" (shouldered celts) और जेडाइट पत्थर के उपकरण मिले हैं?
e: Daojali Hading (Dima Hasao, Assam) and Sarutaru are key North-East Indian Neolithic sites yielding cord-marked pottery, jadeite tools, and shouldered celts.
qe: Which Neolithic site in Assam (North-East India) has yielded distinctive "shouldered celts" (स्कंधयुक्त कुल्हाड़ी) and jadeite stone tools indicating links with East/SE Asia?

q: प्रसिद्ध "पशुपति महादेव" सेलखड़ी मुहर (हाथी, बाघ, गैंडा, भैंसा व दो हिरणों से घिरे त्रिमुखी योगी का अंकन) किस स्थल से प्राप्त हुई थी?
e: Excavated at Mohenjo-daro (identified as Proto-Shiva by Sir John Marshall). Remember the 4 big animals on the Pashupati Seal: Elephant, Tiger, Rhinoceros, Buffalo (NO cow, lion, or horse).
qe: The famous "Pashupati Mahadeva" steatite seal (showing a three-faced seated yogi surrounded by an elephant, tiger, rhinoceros, buffalo, and two deer) was discovered at:

q: सिंध का कौन-सा हड़प्पा स्थल एकमात्र प्रमुख नगर है जहाँ कोई किलेबंद दुर्ग (Citadel) नहीं मिला, और जो शंख व कार्नेलियन मनका निर्माण का विशेष केंद्र था?
e: Chanhudaro (excavated by N. G. Majumdar 1931 & Ernest Mackay 1935) had no citadel and yielded an inkpot, bronze toy cart, and lipstick/cosmetic traces.
qe: Which Harappan site in Sindh is the ONLY major Harappan city excavated without a fortified Citadel (दुर्ग), and was a specialized centre for shell-working and carnelian bead-making?

q: किस उपनिषद में राजा जनक के दरबार में ऋषि याज्ञवल्क्य और विदुषी गार्गी वाचक्नवी के बीच प्रसिद्ध दार्शनिक शास्त्रार्थ संकलित है?
e: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad (oldest and largest Upanishad, attached to Shukla Yajurveda) contains both the Yajnavalkya–Gargi and Yajnavalkya–Maitreyi dialogues.
qe: Which Upanishad contains the celebrated philosophical dialogue between Sage Yajnavalkya and the learned woman philosopher Gargi Vachaknavi at King Janaka's court?

q: सामान्य जनमानस तक सीधे पहुँचने के लिए वर्धमान महावीर ने अपने उपदेश किस भाषा में दिए थे?
e: Mahavira preached in Ardhamagadhi Prakrit (while Gautama Buddha preached in Pali/Magadhi Prakrit), making both heterodox movements accessible to commoners beyond Vedic Sanskrit.
qe: In which language did Vardhamana Mahavira deliver his sermons to reach the common people directly?

q: गौतम बुद्ध के किस प्रमुख शिष्य ने प्रथम बौद्ध संगीति (483 ई.पू., राजगृह) की अध्यक्षता की थी?
e: Mahakassapa presided over the First Council at Saptaparni Cave (Rajagriha) under Ajatashatru; Ananda recited Sutta Pitaka and Upali recited Vinaya Pitaka.
qe: Who was the chief disciple of Gautama Buddha who presided over the First Buddhist Council (483 BCE, Rajagriha)?

q: कर्नाटक में 12वीं शताब्दी के किस समाज सुधारक ने जाति-विरोधी "वीरशैव / लिंगायत" आंदोलन का नेतृत्व किया और कन्नड़ में भक्ति "वचन" रचे?
e: Basavanna (minister of Kalachuri king Bijjala) founded the Anubhava Mantapa and led the Virashaiva/Lingayat movement rejecting caste, ritualism, and gender inequality.
qe: Which 12th-century reformer in Karnataka led the anti-caste "Virashaiva / Lingayat" Shaiva movement and composed devotional Vachanas in Kannada?

q: किस मौर्य सम्राट को उसके अभिलेखों में "देवानांप्रिय" तथा "प्रियदर्शी" की उपाधियों से संबोधित किया गया है?
e: Emperor Ashoka used "Devanampiya Piyadassi" across his edicts; his personal name "Ashoka" appears in Maski, Gujarra, Nettur, and Udegolam minor rock edicts.
qe: Which Mauryan emperor is referred to in his inscriptions by the regal titles "Devanampiya" (Beloved of the Gods) and "Piyadassi" (Of Gracious Appearance)?

q: मेगस्थनीज की "इंडिका" के अनुसार, पाटलिपुत्र का नगर प्रशासन 30 सदस्यों की एक परिषद द्वारा चलाया जाता था जो 5-5 सदस्यों की कितनी समितियों में विभाजित थी?
e: Pataliputra's 30-member municipal board had 6 committees of 5 members each (Industries/Arts, Foreigners, Births & Deaths registration, Trade & Commerce, Manufactured Goods, and Sales Tax of 1/10th). The Mauryan army was similarly managed by 6 boards of 5 members each.
qe: According to Megasthenes' "Indica", the municipal administration of Pataliputra was managed by a council of 30 members divided into how many boards (committees) of 5 members each?

q: 14वीं शताब्दी में सुल्तान फिरोज शाह तुगलक द्वारा टोपरा (हरियाणा) और मेरठ (उ.प्र.) से किन अशोक स्तंभों को दिल्ली ले जाया गया था?
e: Firuz Shah Tughlaq shifted the Topra (the ONLY pillar bearing all 7 Pillar Edicts!) and Meerut pillars to Delhi.
qe: Which Ashokan Pillar Edict was physically transported from Topra (Haryana) and Meerut (UP) to Delhi in the 14th century by Sultan Firuz Shah Tughlaq?

q: साकल (सियालकोट) से शासन करने वाला सबसे महान हिंद-यवन शासक कौन था, जिसने बौद्ध धर्म अपनाया और जो "मिलिंदपन्हो" का नायक है?
e: Menander I (Milinda, 165–130 BCE) was the most celebrated Indo-Greek monarch, known for his dialogue with monk Nagasena.
qe: Who was the greatest Indo-Greek king who ruled from Sakala (Sialkot), embraced Buddhism, and is the protagonist of "Milindapanho"?

q: आंध्र प्रदेश के किस प्रसिद्ध बौद्ध स्तूप—जिसमें सातवाहन व इक्ष्वाकु संरक्षण में सफेद संगमरमर/चूना पत्थर के पट्ट प्रयुक्त हुए—के नाम पर एक विशिष्ट दक्षिण भारतीय मूर्तिकला शैली पड़ी?
e: Amaravati School of Art (Lower Krishna-Godavari valley, white marble, narrative dynamic reliefs) flourished alongside Gandhara and Mathura schools in the Post-Mauryan era.
qe: Which famous Buddhist stupa in Andhra Pradesh—built with white marble/limestone casing slabs under Satavahana and Ikshvaku patronage—gave its name to a distinct South Indian school of sculpture?

q: संस्कृत में बुद्ध के जीवन पर प्राचीनतम उपलब्ध महाकाव्य "बुद्धचरित" के रचयिता तथा चतुर्थ बौद्ध संगीति के उपाध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: Ashvaghosha (originally from Saketa/Ayodhya, patronized by Kanishka) authored Buddhacharita, Saundarananda, and Sariputraprakarana (oldest known Sanskrit drama fragment).
qe: Who authored "Buddhacharita" (the earliest surviving Mahakavya in Sanskrit on Buddha's life) and served as Vice-President of the Fourth Buddhist Council?

q: पश्चिमी मालवा और गुजरात विजय के पश्चात् किस गुप्त सम्राट ने "शकारि" (शकों का नाशक) की उपाधि धारण की तथा प्रथम गुप्त चाँदी के सिक्के (रूपक) जारी किए?
e: Chandragupta II (375–415 CE) defeated Shaka ruler Rudrasimha III, adopted "Vikramaditya" and "Shakari", and made Ujjain his second capital.
qe: Which Gupta emperor assumed the title "Shakari" (Destroyer of Shakas) after conquering Western Malwa and Gujarat, and issued the first Gupta silver coins (Rupakas)?

q: गुप्तयुग के किस प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत नाटककार एवं महाकवि ने "अभिज्ञानशाकुन्तलम्", "मेघदूतम्", "रघुवंशम्" तथा "मालविकाग्निमित्रम्" की रचना की?
e: Kalidasa ("Shakespeare of India") wrote 3 plays (Abhijnanashakuntalam, Malavikagnimitram, Vikramorvashiyam), 2 Mahakavyas (Raghuvamsham, Kumarasambhavam), and 2 Khandakavyas (Meghadutam, Ritusamhara).
qe: Which famous Sanskrit playwright of the Gupta era authored "Abhijnanashakuntalam", "Meghadutam", "Raghuvamsham", and "Malavikagnimitram"?

q: 1,600 से अधिक वर्षों तक लगभग जंग-रहित रहने के लिए प्रसिद्ध महरौली लौह स्तंभ (दिल्ली) पर "चंद्र" नामक राजा की प्रशंसा में संस्कृत अभिलेख है, जिसकी पहचान किससे की जाती है?
e: The Mehrauli Iron Pillar (originally erected as a Vishnudhwaja on Vishnupada hill) records King Chandra's victories over the Vangas (Bengal) and Vahlikas across the seven mouths of the Indus, matching Chandragupta II.
qe: The Mehrauli Iron Pillar (Delhi), celebrated for remaining virtually rust-free for over 1,600 years, bears a Sanskrit inscription praising a king named "Chandra", widely identified with:

q: सम्राट हर्षवर्धन का राजकवि कौन था जिसने उनकी जीवनी "हर्षचरितम्" और प्रसिद्ध गद्यकाव्य "कादम्बरी" की रचना की?
e: Banabhatta wrote Harshacharita (first historical biography in Sanskrit prose) and Kadambari. Mayura (author of Suryashataka) was also at Harsha's court.
qe: Who was the court poet of Emperor Harshavardhana who authored his biography "Harshacharita" and the classic prose romance "Kadambari"?

q: किस चोल सम्राट ने 1025 ई. में बंगाल की खाड़ी के पार श्रीविजय साम्राज्य के विरुद्ध ऐतिहासिक नौसैनिक अभियान भेजा और नई राजधानी "गंगैकोंड चोलपुरम" बसाई?
e: Rajendra I (1014–1044 CE) turned the Bay of Bengal into a "Chola Lake", defeated Mahipala I of Bengal (taking title Gangaikondachola), and excavated the Cholagangam tank.
qe: Which Chola emperor sent a historic naval expedition across the Bay of Bengal in 1025 CE against the Srivijaya Empire (Malay Peninsula & Sumatra) and built the new capital "Gangaikonda Cholapuram"?

q: मध्य प्रदेश में नागर शैली के विश्वप्रसिद्ध खजुराहो मंदिर समूह (कंदरिया महादेव, लक्ष्मण, पार्श्वनाथ मंदिर) किस राजपूत वंश द्वारा बनवाए गए थे?
e: The Chandela rulers (notably Yashovarman, Dhanga, and Vidyadhara, 950–1050 CE) built the Khajuraho temples in sandstone. Exam Boosters: (1) Solankis built the Modhera Sun Temple and Dilwara Jain Temples (Mount Abu).
qe: The famous Khajuraho group of Nagara-style temples (Kandariya Mahadeva, Lakshmana, Parsvanatha temples, UNESCO World Heritage Site) in Madhya Pradesh were built by which Rajput dynasty?

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत की गद्दी पर बैठने वाली प्रथम एवं एकमात्र महिला शासिका (1236–1240 ई.) कौन थीं?
e: Razia Sultan (daughter of Iltutmish) ruled from 1236 to 1240 CE, discarding purdah and holding open court before facing rebellion from the Turkan-i-Chahalgani nobles.
qe: Who was the first and only female ruler to ascend the throne of the Delhi Sultanate (1236–1240 CE)?

q: किस दिल्ली सुल्तान ने "तुर्कान-ए-चहलगानी" की शक्ति को नष्ट किया, "लौह एवं रक्त" की नीति अपनाई तथा फारसी दरबारी प्रथा "सिजदा" व "पाबोस" शुरू की?
e: Balban (1266–1287) propounded the divine kingship theory ("Zil-i-Ilahi" — Shadow of God on Earth), introduced the Persian New Year festival "Nauroz", and established Diwan-i-Arz.
qe: Which Delhi Sultan crushed the power of the "Turkan-i-Chahalgani" (Corps of Forty), adopted the policy of "Blood and Iron", and introduced the Persian court rituals of "Sijda" and "Paibos"?

q: अलाउद्दीन खिलजी का वह प्रसिद्ध सेनापति कौन था जिसने देवगिरि, वारंगल (जहाँ से कोहिनूर हीरा प्राप्त हुआ), द्वारसमुद्र और मदुरै के दक्षिणी अभियानों का नेतृत्व किया?
e: Malik Kafur ("Hazar Dinari", bought in Gujarat campaign) led Alauddin's Deccan expeditions (1307–1311), forcing Yadava, Kakatiya (Prataprudra II), Hoysala, and Pandya rulers to pay tribute.
qe: Who was Alauddin Khalji's celebrated military commander who led the southern campaigns against Devagiri, Warangal (obtaining the Koh-i-Noor diamond), Dwarasamudra, and Madurai?

q: मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक के शासनकाल में 1333 ई. में कौन-सा प्रसिद्ध मोरक्को यात्री भारत आया, 8 वर्षों तक दिल्ली का काजी रहा तथा "किताब-उल-रेहला" लिखी?
e: Ibn Battuta (from Tangier, Morocco) described Delhi, the postal relay system (Uluq & Dawa), and Tughlaq's policies in his Arabic travelogue "Rehla".
qe: Which famous Moroccan traveller arrived in India in 1333 CE during Muhammad bin Tughlaq's reign, served as Qazi of Delhi for 8 years, and authored "Kitab-ul-Rehla"?

q: 1347 ई. में दक्कन में गुलबर्गा (हसनाबाद) को प्रथम राजधानी बनाकर स्वतंत्र "बहमनी साम्राज्य" की स्थापना किसने की थी?
o: Hasan Gangu (अलाउद्दीन हसन बहमन शाह / हसन गंगू)
e: Hasan Gangu (Zafar Khan) revolted against Muhammad bin Tughlaq and founded the Bahmani Sultanate (1347). Later it fragmented into 5 Deccan Sultanates: Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar, Berar, and Bidar.
qe: Who founded the independent "Bahmani Kingdom" in the Deccan in 1347 CE with its first capital at Gulbarga (Hasanabad)?

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत के केंद्रीय प्रशासन में "दीवान-ए-इंशा" विभाग का विशिष्ट उत्तरदायित्व क्या था?
e: Four core Sultanate ministries: Diwan-i-Wizarat (Finance/PM), Diwan-i-Arz (Military), Diwan-i-Insha (Royal Correspondence), and Diwan-i-Risalat (Religious affairs/Foreign appeals).
qe: In the Delhi Sultanate's central administration, what was the specific department headed by the "Diwan-i-Insha" (दीवान-ए-इंशा)?

q: दिल्ली के सात सुल्तानों का शासन देखने वाले अमीर खुसरो ("तूती-ए-हिंद") को किस वाद्य यंत्र तथा संगीत शैली के आविष्कार का श्रेय दिया जाता है?
e: Amir Khusrau blended Persian and Indian musical traditions, pioneering Sitar, Tabla, Qawwali, Tarana, and Khayal, and authoring "Tughlaqnama", "Khazain-ul-Futuh", and "Nuh Sipihr".
qe: Amir Khusrau ("Tuti-i-Hind"), who witnessed the reigns of seven Delhi Sultans, is credited with inventing which musical instrument and poetic/musical style?

q: मुगल सम्राट बाबर ने अपनी प्रसिद्ध आत्मकथा "तुजुक-ए-बाबरी" (बाबरनामा) किस भाषा में लिखी थी?
e: Babur wrote Tuzuk-i-Baburi in his mother tongue Chagatai Turkish; Abdur Rahim Khan-i-Khana later translated it into Persian under Akbar.
qe: In which language did Mughal Emperor Babur write his famous autobiography "Tuzuk-i-Baburi" (Baburnama)?

q: भारत में मुगल सत्ता को पुनः स्थापित करने वाला पानीपत का द्वितीय युद्ध (5 नवंबर 1556) अकबर के संरक्षक बैरम खाँ और किसके बीच लड़ा गया था?
e: Bairam Khan defeated Hemu (Prime Minister & General of Adil Shah Sur, who had captured Delhi and assumed the title Vikramaditya) at Panipat in 1556.
qe: The Second Battle of Panipat (5 November 1556), which re-established Mughal rule in India, was fought between Akbar's regent Bairam Khan and:

q: किस मुगल सम्राट ने 1679 में जजिया कर पुनः लागू किया, शाही दरबार में संगीत पर प्रतिबंध लगाया और जिसे "जिंदा पीर" कहा गया?
e: Aurangzeb (1658–1707) re-imposed Jizya in 1679, discontinued Jharokha Darshan and Nauroz, and expanded the Mughal Empire to its greatest territorial extent (21 Subahs), though Deccan wars drained its resources.
qe: Which Mughal Emperor re-imposed the Jizya tax in 1679, banned music at the imperial court, and was known as "Zinda Pir" (Living Saint)?

q: हल्दीघाटी का युद्ध (18 जून 1576) मेवाड़ के महाराणा प्रताप तथा किसके नेतृत्व वाली मुगल सेना के बीच लड़ा गया था?
o: राजा मानसिंह प्रथम व आसफ खाँ
e: Raja Man Singh of Amber and Asaf Khan led Akbar's forces at Haldighati; Maharana Pratap's Afghan general Hakim Khan Sur commanded his vanguard.
qe: The Battle of Haldighati (18 June 1576) was fought between Maharana Pratap of Mewar and the Mughal army commanded by:
oe: Raja Man Singh I & Asaf Khan

q: सम्राट अकबर द्वारा अपने अनुवाद विभाग (मकतब खाना) में अब्दुल कादिर बदायूनी व नकीब खाँ के नेतृत्व में महाभारत का फारसी अनुवाद किस नाम से कराया गया?
e: Mahabharata was translated as "Razmnama" (Book of Wars). Exam Boosters: (1) Dara Shikoh (Shah Jahan's eldest son) translated 52 Upanishads into Persian as "Sirr-i-Akbar" and wrote "Majma-ul-Bahrain" (Mingling of Two Oceans).
qe: Which Persian translation of the Mahabharata was commissioned by Emperor Akbar at his Maktab Khana (Translation Bureau) under Abdul Qadir Badauni and Naqib Khan?

q: शाहजहाँ के पुत्रों के बीच उत्तराधिकार युद्ध के दौरान कौन-सा प्रसिद्ध फ्रांसीसी चिकित्सक एवं यात्री भारत (1656–1668) आया और "ट्रैवेल्स इन द मुगल एम्पायर" लिखा?
e: François Bernier served as physician to Dara Shikoh and later Danishmand Khan. Exam Boosters: (1) Tavernier was a French jeweller (described the Koh-i-Noor & Peacock Throne); (2) Italian Niccolao Manucci wrote "Storia do Mogor".
qe: Which famous French physician and traveller visited India (1656–1668) during the war of succession between Shah Jahan's sons and wrote "Travels in the Mogul Empire"?

q: छत्रपति शिवाजी की "अष्टप्रधान" मंत्रिपरिषद में विदेश मामलों (आधुनिक विदेश मंत्री के समतुल्य) का प्रभारी मंत्री कौन कहलाता था?
e: Shivaji's Ashtapradhan: Peshwa (PM), Amatya (Finance), Mantri/Waqia-Navis (Intelligence/Home), Sachiv/Shurunavis (Correspondence), Sumant/Dabir (Foreign Affairs), Sar-i-Naubat/Senapati (Army), Panditrao (Religious), Nyayadhish (Justice).
qe: In Chhatrapati Shivaji's "Ashtapradhan" council of ministers, which minister was in charge of Foreign Affairs (corresponding to modern External Affairs Minister)?

q: भारत में दोहरे गुंबद (double dome) और चारबाग शैली का प्रयोग करने वाला प्रथम उद्यान-मकबरा कौन-सा है, जिसने ताजमहल को प्रेरणा दी?
e: Humayun's Tomb (Delhi, built 1569–70 by Haji Begum / Bega Begum, designed by Mirak Mirza Ghiyas) introduced the Charbagh garden-tomb and double dome. Exam Boosters: (1) Itimad-ud-Daulah's Tomb (built by Nur Jahan, 1622–28) was the FIRST Mughal monument built entirely of white marble with Pietra Dura.
qe: Which of the following Mughal architectural monuments is credited with being the FIRST garden-tomb in India using a double dome and Charbagh layout, inspiring the Taj Mahal?

q: 1798 में "सहायक संधि" (Subsidiary Alliance) की नीति किसने प्रारंभ की, जिसे स्वीकार करने वाला पहला भारतीय शासक हैदराबाद का निजाम था?
e: Lord Wellesley (1798–1805) used Subsidiary Alliance to subordinate Hyderabad (1798), Mysore (1799), Tanjore (1799), Awadh (1801), and Peshwa Baji Rao II (Treaty of Bassein, 1802).
qe: Who introduced the "Subsidiary Alliance" (सहायक संधि) policy in 1798, with the Nizam of Hyderabad becoming the first Indian ruler to accept it?

q: 28 दिसंबर 1885 को बंबई में स्थापित "भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस" के संस्थापक तथा प्रथम अध्यक्ष क्रमशः कौन थे?
o: ए. ओ. ह्यूम और डब्ल्यू. सी. बनर्जी
ए. ओ. ह्यूम और बदरुद्दीन तैयबजी
e: Retired ICS officer Allan Octavian Hume founded INC (72 delegates attended; Viceroy was Lord Dufferin), and Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee was its first President. Exam Boosters: (1) First Muslim INC President: Badruddin Tyabji (Madras, 1887); (2) First European INC President: George Yule (Allahabad, 1888).
qe: Who was the founder of the "Indian National Congress" (established on 28 December 1885 at Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College, Bombay), and who was its first President?
oe: A. O. Hume and W. C. Bonnerjee
A. O. Hume and Badruddin Tyabji

q: लॉर्ड कर्जन द्वारा घोषित "बंगाल विभाजन" 16 अक्टूबर 1905 को प्रभावी हुआ। दिल्ली दरबार में किस वर्ष बंगाल विभाजन को रद्द कर दिया गया?
e: At the Delhi Durbar in December 1911 (King George V & Viceroy Lord Hardinge II), the Partition of Bengal was annulled and the capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi (effective 1912).
qe: The "Partition of Bengal" announced by Lord Curzon took effect on 16 October 1905, sparking the Swadeshi and Boycott Movement. In which year was the Partition of Bengal annulled at the Delhi Durbar?

q: 1909 के किस ब्रिटिश अधिनियम—"मार्ले-मिंटो सुधार"—ने भारत में मुसलमानों के लिए "पृथक निर्वाचक मंडल" की विभाजनकारी प्रणाली प्रारंभ की?
e: The Indian Councils Act, 1909 (Lord Minto is called "Father of Communal Electorate") introduced separate electorates and appointed Satyendra Prasanna Sinha as the first Indian member of the Viceroy's Executive Council.
qe: Which British Act of 1909—known as the "Morley-Minto Reforms"—introduced the divisive system of "Separate Electorates" for Muslims in India?

q: "मांटेग्यू-चेम्सफोर्ड सुधार" (भारत शासन अधिनियम, 1919) ने प्रांतों में कौन-सी विशिष्ट दोहरी प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था लागू की?
o: द्वैध शासन — आरक्षित व हस्तांतरित विषय
e: The 1919 Act introduced Provincial Dyarchy (Reserved subjects under Governor + Executive Council; Transferred subjects under Governor + Indian Ministers), bicameralism at the Centre, and created the Central Public Service Commission (1926).
qe: The "Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms" (Government of India Act, 1919) introduced which unique dual administrative system in the provinces?

q: 1928 के "बारदोली सत्याग्रह" (गुजरात) के प्रमुख नेता कौन थे, जहाँ बारदोली की महिलाओं ने उन्हें "सरदार" की उपाधि प्रदान की थी?
e: Vallabhbhai Patel led the no-tax campaign against an unjust 22% land revenue hike in Bardoli (Surat), forcing the Maxwell-Broomfield Committee to cut the hike to 6.03%.
qe: Who was the renowned peasant leader of the "Bardoli Satyagraha" (1928, Gujarat), where the women of Bardoli conferred upon him the title "Sardar"?

q: व्यक्तिगत सत्याग्रह आंदोलन (अक्टूबर 1940, पवनार आश्रम) के दौरान महात्मा गांधी द्वारा प्रथम व्यक्तिगत सत्याग्रही किसे चुना गया था?
e: Acharya Vinoba Bhave was the 1st Individual Satyagrahi, Jawaharlal Nehru the 2nd, and Brahma Dutt the 3rd (also called "Delhi Chalo" movement). Vinoba Bhave later launched the Bhoodan Movement (1951, Pochampally, Telangana).
qe: Who was chosen by Mahatma Gandhi as the FIRST Individual Satyagrahi (October 1940, Paunar Ashram) during the Individual Satyagraha movement?

q: 1859–60 में दीनबंधु मित्र ने प्रसिद्ध बांग्ला नाटक "नील दर्पण" लिखा, जिसमें किस विद्रोह के दौरान किसानों के क्रूर शोषण को उजागर किया गया?
e: The Indigo Revolt (Nadia district, Bengal, led by Digambar Biswas & Bishnu Biswas) forced the British to appoint the Indigo Commission (1860). Exam Boosters: (1) Santhal Rebellion (1855–56, Rajmahal hills) was led by Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu.
qe: In 1859–60, Dinabandhu Mitra wrote the famous Bengali play "Neel Darpan" (translated into English by Michael Madhusudan Dutt) exposing the brutal exploitation of peasants during which revolt?

q: तेज बहादुर सप्रू के साथ लंदन में आयोजित तीनों गोलमेज सम्मेलनों (1930, 1931, 1932) में भाग लेने वाले प्रमुख भारतीय नेता कौन थे?
e: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar (and Tej Bahadur Sapru) attended all three Round Table Conferences. Mahatma Gandhi (representing INC) attended ONLY the Second Round Table Conference (Sept–Dec 1931) following the Gandhi-Irwin Pact.
qe: Who was the ONLY Indian leader to attend ALL THREE Round Table Conferences (1930, 1931, 1932) in London along with Tej Bahadur Sapru?

q: भारतीय स्वतंत्रता अधिनियम, 1947 के अंतर्गत स्वतंत्र भारत के प्रथम गवर्नर-जनरल तथा प्रथम एवं एकमात्र भारतीय गवर्नर-जनरल क्रमशः कौन थे?
o: लॉर्ड वेवेल और डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद
सी. राजगोपालाचारी और डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद
e: Lord Mountbatten was the first Governor-General of independent India (Aug 1947–June 1948), succeeded by Chakravarti Rajagopalachari (June 1948–Jan 1950), the first and last Indian Governor-General before India became a Republic.
qe: Under the Indian Independence Act, 1947 (based on the 3 June Mountbatten Plan), who served as the FIRST Governor-General of Independent India and who became the FIRST and ONLY Indian Governor-General of Independent India respectively?
oe: Lord Wavell and Dr. Rajendra Prasad
C. Rajagopalachari and Dr. Rajendra Prasad

q: कौन-सी भूकंपीय तरंगें पृथ्वी के आंतरिक भाग में सबसे तेज गति से चलती हैं और ठोस, द्रव व गैस तीनों माध्यमों से गुजर सकती हैं?
e: P-waves (longitudinal/compressional) are fastest and pass through all states of matter. S-waves (transverse) CANNOT pass through liquids (proving the Earth's Outer Core is liquid). Surface waves (L-waves) cause maximum destruction.
qe: Which earthquake seismic waves travel the FASTEST through the Earth's interior and can pass through solids, liquids, and gases?

q: चूना पत्थर, बलुआ पत्थर और शेल किस प्रमुख चट्टान वर्ग के उदाहरण हैं, जिनमें प्रायः जीवाश्म तथा जीवाश्म ईंधन (कोयला व पेट्रोलियम) पाए जाते हैं?
e: Sedimentary rocks form in layers (strata) by lithification of eroded sediments and cover ~75% of the Earth's land surface (though only ~5% of crustal volume). Exam Boosters: (1) Metamorphic equivalents: Limestone → Marble; Sandstone → Quartzite; Shale → Slate; Granite → Gneiss.
qe: Limestone, sandstone, and shale are classic examples of which major rock group, often containing fossils and fossil fuels (coal & petroleum)?

q: किस वायुमंडलीय परत में सुरक्षात्मक "ओजोन परत" स्थित है, जो हानिकारक पराबैंगनी (UV) विकिरण को अवशोषित करती है और ऊँचाई के साथ तापमान बढ़ाती है?
e: The Stratosphere (extending from tropopause to ~50 km) houses the ozone concentration (~20–35 km) and is ideal for commercial jet aircraft due to absence of weather turbulence.
qe: Which atmospheric layer contains the protective "Ozone Layer" (ozonosphere) that absorbs harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation and causes temperature to rise with altitude?

q: पश्चिमी प्रशांत महासागर में स्थित पृथ्वी का सबसे गहरा ज्ञात महासागरीय गर्त (चैलेंजर डीप, ~11,000 मीटर) कौन-सा है?
e: Mariana Trench (Pacific Ocean) is the deepest oceanic trench. Exam Boosters: (1) Deepest trench in Indian Ocean: Sunda (Java) Trench; (2) Deepest trench in Atlantic Ocean: Puerto Rico Trench.
qe: Which is the deepest known oceanic trench on Earth, located in the western Pacific Ocean (Challenger Deep, ~11,000 m)?

q: भूमध्य सागर के लिपारी द्वीप पर स्थित किस प्रसिद्ध ज्वालामुखी को निरंतर सक्रिय रहने के कारण "भूमध्य सागर का प्रकाश स्तंभ" कहा जाता है?
e: Mount Stromboli (Italy) erupts rhythmically and is dubbed the "Lighthouse of the Mediterranean". Exam Boosters: (1) Highest active volcano: Ojos del Salado / Cotopaxi (Andes); (2) India's only active volcano: Barren Island (Andaman Sea).
qe: Which famous volcano on Lipari Island in the Mediterranean Sea is called the "Lighthouse of the Mediterranean" due to its continuous mild eruptions?

q: "गरजता चालीसा" (Roaring Forties), "प्रचंड पचासा" और "चीखता साठा" क्या हैं?
o: दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में 40° से 60° दक्षिण के बीच चलने वाली तीव्र पछुआ पवनें
हिंद महासागर की उष्णकटिबंधीय मानसूनी पवनें
e: Because the Southern Hemisphere has minimal landmass between 40°S and 60°S, friction is low and Westerlies blow with tremendous velocity.
qe: What are the "Roaring Forties" (गरजता चालीसा), "Furious Fifties", and "Shrieking Sixties"?
oe: Trade Winds in the Northern Hemisphere
Strong, persistent Westerly winds in the Southern Hemisphere between 40°S and 60°S
Tropical monsoon winds over the Indian Ocean

q: किस प्रकार का बादल ऊँचाई में फैला निहाई (anvil) के आकार का होता है जो भारी गरज-चमक, बिजली और ओलावृष्टि के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
e: Cumulonimbus clouds extend vertically from low base to tropopause, producing intense convectional downpours, thunder, and hail. Exam Boosters: (1) Cirrus are highest feathery ice-crystal clouds; (2) Nimbostratus produce steady continuous rain.
qe: Which type of cloud is a towering, anvil-shaped vertical cloud responsible for heavy thunderstorms, lightning, and hailstorms?

q: विश्व के सबसे समृद्ध समुद्री मत्स्य क्षेत्र—जैसे न्यूफाउंडलैंड के पास ग्रैंड बैंक तथा जापान तट—मुख्यतः कहाँ विकसित होते हैं?
o: जहाँ गर्म और ठंडी महासागरीय धाराएँ मिलती हैं
जहाँ महासागरीय गर्त 8,000 मी से गहरे हों
जहाँ गर्म धाराएँ प्रवाल भित्तियों पर बहें
e: Meeting of warm and cold currents (Gulf Stream + Labrador at Grand Banks; Kuroshio + Oyashio off Japan) mixes nutrients and fuels abundant plankton growth (though also creating dense fog).
qe: The world's richest marine fishing grounds—such as the Grand Banks (off Newfoundland) and coastal Japan—occur primarily where:
oe: Warm and cold ocean currents converge
Deep ocean trenches drop below 8,000 m
Warm currents flow over equatorial coral reefs

q: उत्तरी अटलांटिक महासागर का कौन-सा सागर बिना किसी स्थलीय सीमा के (केवल चार महासागरीय धाराओं से घिरा) तथा तैरती समुद्री घास के लिए अद्वितीय है?
e: The Sargasso Sea (named after floating Sargassum seaweed) lies inside the North Atlantic subtropical gyre and is the only sea on Earth without a land coastline.
qe: Which sea in the North Atlantic Ocean is unique for having NO land boundaries—bounded solely by four ocean currents (Gulf Stream, North Atlantic Drift, Canary, and North Equatorial)—and is covered with floating seaweed?

q: कौन-सी मृदा—जिसे "चेर्नोज़ेम" (काली मिट्टी) कहा जाता है—अत्यधिक उपजाऊ, ह्यूमस से भरपूर है और यूक्रेन व रूस के स्टेपी क्षेत्र में विशाल गेहूँ उत्पादन करती है?
e: Chernozem (Mollisol) forms under temperate steppe grasslands with thick dark organic-rich topsoil, making Ukraine the "Breadbasket of Europe".
qe: Which soil type—known as "Chernozem" (Black Earth)—is extraordinarily fertile, rich in humus, and supports massive wheat production in the Ukrainian and Russian Steppes?

q: डब्ल्यू. एम. डेविस के "अपरदन के भौगोलिक चक्र" (1899) में वृद्धावस्था में निर्मित लगभग समतल मैदान, जिस पर प्रतिरोधी अवशिष्ट पहाड़ियाँ ("मोनाडनॉक") बची रहती हैं, क्या कहलाता है?
e: Davis termed the old-age fluvial surface a "Peneplain" with residual Monadnocks. Exam Boosters: (1) Walther Penck: "Endrumpf" with Inselbergs; (2) L. C. King: "Pediplain" (arid/semi-arid cycle); (3) C. H. Crickmay: "Panplain".
qe: In W. M. Davis's "Geographical Cycle of Erosion" (1899), the almost flat, featureless lowland punctuated by isolated resistant hills ("Monadnocks") formed in the Old Age stage is called:

q: प्रवाल भित्तियों के तटीय प्रवाल भित्ति (Fringing) → अवरोधक प्रवाल भित्ति (Barrier) → वलयाकार प्रवाल द्वीप (Atoll) में क्रमिक विकास हेतु "अवतलन सिद्धांत" किसने प्रतिपादित किया?
e: Charles Darwin proposed the Subsidence Theory after the HMS Beagle voyage. Exam Boosters: (1) Daly (1915): Glacial Control Theory; (2) Murray (1880): Standstill Theory.
qe: Who proposed the "Subsidence Theory" (अवतलन सिद्धांत, 1837/1842) explaining the progressive evolution of Coral Reefs from Fringing Reef → Barrier Reef → Atoll?

q: मौसम विज्ञान में "तापमान व्युत्क्रमण" (Temperature Inversion) क्या है, और शांत स्वच्छ शीतकालीन रात्रियों में यह सर्वाधिक कहाँ देखा जाता है?
o: महासागरों पर तापमान 10°C/किमी से तेज गिरता है
ऊँचाई के साथ तापमान घटने के बजाय बढ़ता है, विशेषतः अंतरापर्वतीय घाटियों में
क्षोभसीमा पर वायुदाब शून्य हो जाता है
भारी वर्षा में सापेक्ष आर्द्रता शून्य हो जाती है
e: During clear calm winter nights, rapid terrestrial radiation cools mountain slopes, and dense cold air drains down into valley floors (Air Drainage), creating frost on valley bottoms while upper slopes remain warmer (hence orchards/settlements sit on mid-slopes!).
qe: What is "Temperature Inversion" (तापमान व्युत्क्रमण) in meteorology, and where is it most commonly observed on calm, clear winter nights?
oe: Temperature decreases faster than 10°C/km over oceans
Temperature INCREASES with altitude instead of decreasing, especially in intermontane valleys
Air pressure drops to zero at the tropopause
Relative humidity falls to 0% during heavy rainfall

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ब्लॉक पर्वत (हॉर्स्ट) और भ्रंश घाटी (ग्राबेन) का युग्म सही सुमेलित है?
o: वॉस्जेस व ब्लैक फॉरेस्ट — राइन भ्रंश घाटी
e: The Rhine River flows through a classic Graben (rift valley) flanked by two Block Mountains (Horsts)—the Vosges (France) on the west and the Black Forest (Germany) on the east.
qe: Which of the following pairs of Block Mountains (Horsts) and Rift Valleys (Grabens) is correctly matched?
oe: Vosges & Black Forest Mountains — Rhine Rift Valley

q: मानव भूगोल में "संभववाद" (Possibilism) शब्द का सर्वप्रथम प्रयोग किस फ्रांसीसी विद्वान ने किया था?
e: French historian Lucien Febvre coined the term "Possibilism" (building on Paul Vidal de la Blache's school of thought). Semple and Huntington were leading Environmental Determinists.
qe: Who coined the term "Possibilism" (संभववाद — "Nature sets no necessities, but offers possibilities everywhere") in Human Geography?

q: मानव की कौन-सी प्रजाति मुख्यतः पीले-भूरे रंग की त्वचा, एपिकैंथिक नेत्र-वलय, सीधे काले बाल और पूर्वी एवं दक्षिण-पूर्वी एशिया में निवास के लिए जानी जाती है?
e: Mongoloid populations are native to East Asia, SE Asia, Siberia, and indigenous Americas.
qe: Which race/ethnic group of humans is predominantly characterized by yellowish-brown skin, epicanthic eye fold, straight black hair, and inhabits East & South-East Asia?

q: हिमालय में गुज्जर, बकरवाल, गद्दी व भोटिया जैसे पशुपालकों द्वारा शीतकाल में निचली घाटियों तथा ग्रीष्मकाल में ऊँचे बुग्याल चारागाहों की ओर मौसमी प्रवास क्या कहलाता है?
e: Transhumance (ऋतु-प्रवास) is seasonal up-and-down movement between fixed summer alpine pastures (Bugyals/Margs) and winter valley settlements.
qe: The seasonal vertical migration of pastoralists with their livestock from lowlands in winter to high alpine pastures in summer (e.g., Gujjars, Bakarwals, Gaddis, Bhotiyas in the Himalayas) is termed:

q: 1885 में "प्रवास के नियम" (Laws of Migration) किस भूगोलवेत्ता ने प्रतिपादित किए, जिसमें बताया गया कि अधिकांश प्रवासी कम दूरी तय करते हैं और प्रत्येक धारा की एक प्रतिधारा होती है?
e: Ernst Georg Ravenstein formulated the Laws of Migration (1885). Exam Boosters: (1) Everett Lee (1966): Push–Pull & Intervening Obstacles model; (2) Warren Thompson (1929) & Frank Notestein: Demographic Transition Theory.
qe: Which geographer authored the pioneering 1885 paper "The Laws of Migration" (stating that most migrants move short distances, migration proceeds step-by-step, and every flow generates a counter-flow)?

q: नगरीय भूगोल में किसी बड़े महानगर के चारों ओर स्थित वह संक्रमण क्षेत्र, जहाँ ग्रामीण और नगरीय भूमि-उपयोग आपस में घुलते-मिलते हैं, क्या कहलाता है?
e: The Rural-Urban Fringe lies at the outer edge of cities undergoing rapid suburbanization, real estate expansion, and mixed agricultural-industrial land use.
qe: In urban geography, the transition zone surrounding a large metropolis where rural and urban land uses intermix dynamically is called the:

q: 5 खंडों में प्रसिद्ध ग्रंथ "कॉसमॉस" (Cosmos) के लेखक कौन थे, जिन्हें कार्ल रिटर ("अर्डकुंडे") के साथ आधुनिक भूगोल का सह-संस्थापक माना जाता है?
e: Alexander von Humboldt (1769–1859) pioneered systematic physical geography, isotherms, and plant geography ("Cosmos"). Carl Ritter (1779–1859) pioneered regional geography ("Erdkunde"). Exam Boosters: (1) Varenius wrote "Geographia Generalis" (1650).
qe: Who authored "Cosmos" (5 volumes) and is celebrated alongside Carl Ritter ("Erdkunde") as a co-founder of Modern Geography?

q: फ्रेड के. शेफर द्वारा अपवादवाद की आलोचना से प्रेरित होकर "मात्रात्मक क्रांति" (सांख्यिकीय मॉडलों व स्थानिक ज्यामिति का प्रयोग) ने किस दशक में मानव भूगोल को रूपांतरित किया?
e: Sparked by Schaefer's 1953 paper "Exceptionalism in Geography", the Quantitative Revolution peaked in the 1950s–1960s (Peter Haggett, Richard Chorley, William Bunge), followed by Behavioural and Radical Geography in the 1970s.
qe: In which decade did the "Quantitative Revolution" (मात्रात्मक क्रांति — applying statistical models and spatial geometry) transform Human Geography, pioneered by Fred K. Schaefer's critique of exceptionalism?

q: बी. एस. गुहा के भारतीय जनसंख्या के प्रजातीय वर्गीकरण (1931 जनगणना) के अनुसार भारत में आने वाला सबसे प्राचीन प्रजातीय तत्व कौन-सा है (वर्तमान में कादर, इरुला व अंडमानी जनजातियाँ)?
e: B. S. Guha classified Indians into 6 groups: Negrito (earliest), Proto-Australoid, Mongoloid, Mediterranean, Western Brachycephals, and Nordic (latest).
qe: According to B. S. Guha's racial classification of the Indian population (1931 Census), which is the OLDEST racial element to arrive in India (represented today by Kadars, Irulas, and Andamanese tribes)?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक "स्वच्छंद उद्योग" (Footloose Industry) है जो किसी विशिष्ट कच्चे माल के स्रोत से बँधा नहीं होता?
o: Watchmaking Industry (इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, सॉफ्टवेयर एवं घड़ी निर्माण उद्योग)
e: Footloose industries use light, high-value, non-weight-losing components (e.g., electronics, IT, precision instruments, diamonds), unlike raw-material-bound steel, sugar, and cement industries.
qe: Which of the following is a "Footloose Industry" (स्वच्छंद उद्योग) that is NOT tied to any specific raw material source and can be located almost anywhere with good transport and skilled labour?

q: कौन-सा देश विश्व में प्राकृतिक रबर का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक और निर्यातक है (इंडोनेशिया व मलेशिया के साथ वैश्विक उत्पादन में अग्रणी)?
e: Thailand leads global natural rubber production (followed by Indonesia and Vietnam). In India, Kerala accounts for over 70% of natural rubber production.
qe: Which country is the world's largest producer and exporter of Natural Rubber (and along with Indonesia & Malaysia dominates global rubber output)?

q: विश्व की सबसे लंबी पार-महाद्वीपीय रेल लाइन (~9,289 किमी) कौन-सी है जो यूरोपीय रूस के मॉस्को को प्रशांत तट के व्लादिवोस्तोक से जोड़ती है?
e: Trans-Siberian Railway (double-tracked, electrified) links Moscow to Vladivostok via Omsk, Novosibirsk, and Irkutsk. Exam Boosters: (1) Canadian Pacific Railway links Halifax/Montreal to Vancouver.
qe: Which transcontinental railway is the LONGEST railway line in the world (~9,289 km), connecting Moscow (St. Petersburg) in European Russia to Vladivostok on the Pacific coast?

q: कोयले की किस किस्म में कार्बन की मात्रा सर्वाधिक (85%–95%) होती है, जो बिना धुएँ की नीली लौ के साथ जलता है और सर्वोत्तम श्रेणी का कोयला है?
e: Coal rank from highest to lowest carbon: Anthracite (85–95%, found in India only in J&K/Kalakot) → Bituminous (60–80%, bulk of Indian Gondwana coal) → Lignite (40–55%, Neyveli in TN) → Peat (<40%).
qe: Which coal variety has the HIGHEST carbon content (85%–95%), burns with a smokeless blue flame, and is the highest-grade coal?

q:
सूची-I (प्रमुख तेल क्षेत्र) को सूची-II (देश) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. घावर क्षेत्र — (a) रूस
2. बुर्गान क्षेत्र — (b) सऊदी अरब
3. किरकुक क्षेत्र — (c) कुवैत
4. वोल्गा-यूराल क्षेत्र — (d) इराक
e: Ghawar (world's largest conventional onshore oil field): Saudi Arabia (1-b); Burgan: Kuwait (2-c); Kirkuk: Iraq (3-d); Volga-Ural: Russia (4-a).
qe:
Match List-I (Major Oil / Gas Field) with List-II (Country):
1. Ghawar Field (घावर क्षेत्र) — (a) Russia
2. Burgan Field (बुर्गान क्षेत्र) — (b) Saudi Arabia
3. Kirkuk Field (किरकुक क्षेत्र) — (c) Kuwait
4. Baku / Volga-Ural (बाकू / वोल्गा-यूराल) — (d) Iraq

q: अंगूर की खेती (विटिकल्चर), जैतून और खट्टे रसीले फलों के बागान विश्व की किस जलवायु पेटी की प्रमुख वाणिज्यिक कृषि विशेषता हैं?
e: Mediterranean regions (Southern Europe, California, Central Chile, SW South Africa, SW Australia) are called the "Orchards of the World".
qe: The "Viticulture" (grape cultivation for wine), olive groves, and citrus fruit orchards are the signature commercial agricultural specialization of which global climatic belt?

q: एल्युमीनियम के प्रमुख अयस्क "बॉक्साइट" के वैश्विक उत्पादन में कौन-से दो देश विश्व में अग्रणी हैं?
e: Australia and Guinea dominate global bauxite production and reserves. In India, Odisha (Koraput/Panchpatmali) is the largest producer of bauxite.
qe: Which two countries together control the world's largest reserves of "Bauxite" (the primary ore of Aluminium), with Australia and Guinea leading global production?

q: अल्फ्रेड वेबर के न्यूनतम-लागत दृष्टिकोण के विपरीत, ऑगस्ट लॉश के "बाजार क्षेत्र सिद्धांत" (1940) में किसी फर्म द्वारा आदर्श अवस्थिति चुनने का मुख्य लक्ष्य क्या होता है?
o: केवल कच्चे माल की परिवहन लागत न्यूनतम करना
षट्कोणीय बाजार क्षेत्रों के अनुकूलन द्वारा अधिकतम कुल लाभ अर्जित करना
केवल सस्ते जलविद्युत केंद्र के पास स्थापित होना
सभी क्षेत्रों में मजदूरी दरें समान करना
e: Unlike Weber (who assumed constant demand and minimized costs), August Lösch incorporated spatial demand curves and profit maximization, deriving hexagonal market areas (demand cones).
qe: In August Lösch's "Market Area Theory of Industrial Location" (1940, "The Economics of Location"), what is the primary goal of a firm choosing its optimal location—in contrast to Alfred Weber's least-cost approach?
oe: Minimizing raw material transport cost only
Maximizing total profit (revenue minus cost) by optimizing hexagonal market areas
Locating exclusively near cheap hydroelectric power
Equalizing wage rates across all regions

q: उत्तर-पूर्वी संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका और पश्चिमी यूरोप के महानगरों के आसपास व्यापक रूप से प्रचलित "ट्रक फार्मिंग" (Truck Farming) क्या है?
o: ग्रामीण कारखानों में भारी वाणिज्यिक ट्रकों का निर्माण
ताजी सब्जियों व फलों की विशिष्ट गहन खेती जिन्हें रातों-रात तेज ट्रकों से शहरी बाजारों में भेजा जाता है
शुष्क मरुस्थलों में निर्वाह बाजरा कृषि
e: Truck farming ("market gardening" in Europe) focuses on perishable high-value vegetables/fruits grown near rapid transport corridors serving distant urban centres.
qe: What is "Truck Farming" (ट्रक फार्मिंग), widely practiced in the northeastern United States and around major Western European metropolitan areas?
oe: Manufacturing heavy commercial trucks in rural factories
Specialized intensive cultivation of fresh vegetables and fruits shipped overnight by fast trucks to urban markets
Raising cattle inside mobile refrigerated trailers
Subsistence millet farming in arid deserts

q: मलेशिया/सिंगापुर और सुमात्रा (इंडोनेशिया) के बीच स्थित कौन-सा अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलडमरूमध्य हिंद महासागर को दक्षिण चीन सागर से जोड़ने वाला विश्व का सबसे व्यस्त समुद्री व्यापार मार्ग है?
e: Strait of Malacca handles ~25–30% of global maritime trade. Exam Boosters: (1) Strait of Hormuz: Persian Gulf & Gulf of Oman; (2) Bab el-Mandeb: Red Sea & Gulf of Aden; (3) Gibraltar: Mediterranean Sea & Atlantic Ocean.
qe: Which international strait—situated between Malaysia/Singapore and Sumatra (Indonesia)—is one of the busiest maritime trade chokepoints in the world, linking the Indian Ocean to the South China Sea?

q: पूर्वी भारत (झारखंड, ओडिशा, पश्चिम बंगाल व छत्तीसगढ़) का कौन-सा पठार भारत का सबसे समृद्ध खनिज भंडार है और "भारत का रूर" कहलाता है?
e: Chota Nagpur Plateau (drained by Damodar, Subarnarekha, Barakar rivers) holds vast deposits of coal (Jharia, Bokaro, Raniganj), iron ore, mica, copper, and bauxite.
qe: Which plateau in eastern India (spanning Jharkhand, Odisha, West Bengal, and Chhattisgarh) is the richest mineral storehouse of India, famously called the "Ruhr of India"?

q: असम में ब्रह्मपुत्र नदी द्वारा निर्मित विश्व का सबसे बड़ा नदी द्वीप कौन-सा है?
e: Majuli (Assam, declared India's first island district in 2016) is the world's largest inhabited river island, famous for Neo-Vaishnavite Satras founded by Srimanta Sankardev.
qe: Which is the largest river island in the world, formed by the Brahmaputra River in Assam?

q: जम्मू-कश्मीर / लद्दाख में कौन-सा दर्रा महान हिमालय के पार श्रीनगर को लेह (NH-1) से जोड़ता है?
e: Zoji La connects Srinagar (Kashmir) to Kargil & Leh (Ladakh). Exam Boosters: (1) Banihal Pass (Jawahar Tunnel) connects Jammu to Srinagar; (2) Rohtang Pass (Atal Tunnel, 9.02 km) connects Kullu to Lahaul-Spiti (HP).
qe: Which pass in Jammu & Kashmir / Ladakh connects Srinagar to Leh (National Highway 1) across the Great Himalayas?

q: हुगली नदी बेसिन के सहारे केंद्रित कौन-सा भारतीय राज्य जूट ("सुनहरा रेशा") का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक है?
e: West Bengal produces over 75% of India's raw jute and hosts the majority of India's jute mills (first jute mill established at Rishra near Kolkata in 1855).
qe: Which Indian state is the largest producer of Jute ("Golden Fibre"), concentrated along the Hooghly River basin?

q:
सूची-I (पश्चिमी घाट के दर्रे) को सूची-II (जुड़ने वाले नगर) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. थाल घाट — (a) मुंबई से पुणे
2. भोर घाट — (b) मुंबई से नासिक
3. पालघाट — (c) तिरुवनंतपुरम से मदुरै
4. सेनकोट्टा गैप — (d) कोच्चि से कोयंबटूर
e: North-to-South passes of Western Ghats: Thal Ghat (Mumbai–Nashik, 1-b) → Bhor Ghat (Mumbai–Pune, 2-a) → Pal Ghat (between Nilgiris & Anamalai, Kochi–Coimbatore, 3-d) → Shencottah Gap (between Cardamom & Agasthyamalai hills, 4-c).
qe:
Match List-I (Major Mountain Gap / Pass in Western Ghats) with List-II (Cities Connected):
1. Thal Ghat (थाल घाट) — (a) Mumbai to Pune
2. Bhor Ghat (भोर घाट) — (b) Mumbai to Nashik
3. Pal Ghat / Palakkad Gap (पालघाट) — (c) Thiruvananthapuram to Madurai
4. Shencottah Gap (सेनकोट्टा गैप) — (d) Kochi / Palakkad to Coimbatore

q: भारतीय जलवायु विज्ञान में "आम्र वर्षा" (Mango Showers) और "चेरी ब्लॉसम" (कॉफी वर्षा) क्या हैं?
o: पंजाब व हरियाणा में शीतकालीन चक्रवाती वर्षा
केरल व कर्नाटक में अप्रैल–मई की मानसून-पूर्व वर्षा जो आम पकने व कॉफी के फूल खिलने में सहायक है
थार मरुस्थल की गर्म शुष्क पवनें
e: Pre-monsoon local storms: Mango Showers (Kerala/coastal Karnataka), Blossom Showers (coffee in Karnataka/Kerala), Kalbaisakhi / Nor'westers (Bengal & Assam — "Bardoli Chheerha" in Assam).
qe: What are "Mango Showers" (आम्र वर्षा) and "Cherry Blossoms" (कॉफी वर्षा) in Indian climatology?
oe: Winter cyclonic rains in Punjab and Haryana
Pre-monsoon convectional thunderstorms in Kerala and Karnataka (April–May) aiding mango ripening and coffee flowering
Post-monsoon cyclones striking Odisha in November
Hot dry winds blowing across the Thar Desert

q: असम का कौन-सा तेल क्षेत्र भारत का सबसे पुराना तेल क्षेत्र व रिफाइनरी (खोज 1889, रिफाइनरी 1901) है?
e: Digboi (Tinsukia, Assam) is Asia's oldest operating refinery. Exam Boosters: (1) Mumbai High (offshore Arabian Sea, discovered 1974) is India's largest single oilfield. (2) Ankleshwar, Kalol, and Mehsana are major Gujarat onshore oilfields.
qe: Which oilfield in Assam is the OLDEST continuously operating oil refinery and oilfield in India (discovered 1889, refinery commissioned 1901)?

q: भारत के सर्वाधिक भौगोलिक क्षेत्र में किस प्रकार की प्राकृतिक वनस्पति (सागौन, साल, शीशम, चंदन व महुआ सहित) फैली हुई है?
e: Tropical Deciduous Forests (70–200 cm annual rainfall; divided into Moist Deciduous and Dry Deciduous) cover the largest forest area in India.
qe: Which type of natural vegetation covers the LARGEST geographical area in India (including Teak, Sal, Shisham, Sandalwood, and Mahua)?

q: अमेरिका की टेनेसी वैली अथॉरिटी (TVA) की तर्ज पर 1948 में प्रारंभ हुई स्वतंत्र भारत की प्रथम बहुउद्देशीय नदी घाटी परियोजना कौन-सी है?
e: DVC (1948) tamed the Damodar River ("Sorrow of Bengal") through dams at Tilaiya, Konar, Maithon, and Panchet.
qe: Which major multipurpose project—India's first after Independence (1948), modeled on the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) of the USA—controls floods and generates power in Jharkhand & West Bengal?

q: दामोदर, सोन, महानदी और गोदावरी नदी घाटियों में निर्मित भारत की कौन-सी भूगर्भीय चट्टान प्रणाली भारत के 98% से अधिक कोयला भंडार को धारण करती है?
e: Gondwana rock system holds >98% of India's coal. Exam Boosters: (1) Dharwar system (Karnataka/Jharkhand/Odisha) is the richest in metallic minerals (iron ore, gold, manganese, copper). (2) Vindhyan system is famous for building stones (red sandstone, limestone) and Panna diamonds.
qe: Which geological rock system in India—formed during the Carboniferous–Permian–Jurassic periods in river basins like Damodar, Son, Mahanadi, and Godavari—accounts for over 98% of India's coal reserves?

q:
प्रायद्वीपीय भारतीय अपवाह तंत्र के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: कावेरी नदी लगभग बारहमासी है क्योंकि इसके ऊपरी जलग्रहण क्षेत्र को दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून (ग्रीष्म) तथा निचले क्षेत्र को उत्तर-पूर्वी मानसून (शीत) से वर्षा मिलती है।
कथन II: राजस्थान की लूनी नदी एक मौसमी अंतःस्थलीय अपवाह नदी है जो खुले समुद्र तक पहुँचे बिना कच्छ के रण में विलुप्त हो जाती है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो I और न ही II
e: Both statements are completely accurate (classic UP TGT Geography facts). Note also that Luni is fresh above Balotra and turns saline below Balotra.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Peninsular Indian drainage:
Statement I: The Kaveri River is nearly perennial because its upper catchment receives rainfall from the South-West Monsoon (summer) while its lower catchment receives rainfall from the North-East Monsoon (winter).
Statement II: The Luni River of Rajasthan is an ephemeral inland drainage river that disappears into the Rann of Kachchh without reaching the open sea.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: भारतीय पर्वत शिखरों और उनकी पर्वत श्रेणियों / राज्यों के निम्नलिखित युग्मों में से कौन-सा सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Mahendragiri (1,501 m) is a famous peak of the EASTERN GHATS in Gajapati district, Odisha—NOT the Western Ghats in Kerala (Kerala's highest peak is Anamudi). Dhupgarh (1,350 m, Mahadeo Hills), Parasnath (1,365 m), and Saramati (3,826 m) are correctly matched.
qe: Which of the following pairs of Indian Mountain Peaks and their Mountain Ranges / States is NOT correctly matched?

q: भारत के उत्तर-दक्षिण गलियारा (श्रीनगर–कन्याकुमारी) और पूर्व-पश्चिम गलियारा (सिलचर–पोरबंदर) उत्तर प्रदेश के किस नगर में एक-दूसरे को काटते हैं?
e: The North-South Corridor (4,000 km) and East-West Corridor (3,300 km) intersect at Jhansi in Uttar Pradesh. Exam Boosters: (1) Golden Quadrilateral links Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.
qe: In the Golden Quadrilateral (स्वर्णिम चतुर्भुज, 5,846 km) highway network and the North-South / East-West Corridors of India, at which city in Uttar Pradesh do the North-South Corridor (Srinagar–Kanyakumari) and the East-West Corridor (Silchar–Porbandar) intersect?
